item.text:
No actionable correctness or security blockers found in the supplied evidence.

The previous transport-execution finding is addressed: skill reads use pinned Git with a restricted environment, an empty protocol allowlist, and lazy fetching disabled. The supplied regression targets the missing-promised-blob attack path.

Missing evidence: actual test/build results and a successful real-container probe run; test definitions alone do not establish execution.

RE5 scenarios remain pending as stated, not a code defect. This review does not establish overall acceptance or human approval.
